name: Teni Fortifikara
source:
Shadows of Fortificar is a hybrid narrative RPG and visual novel inspired by Dungeons & Dragons 4th Edition.

You play as one of five characters, each offering a unique perspective on the story and their own distinct mechanics. The story unfolds in an original setting - the city of Fortificar, ravaged by an incurable plague.

You play as one of the members of a classic D&D-style adventuring party, drawn into the dark story of the city of Fortificar.

[From [url=https://reddreamsstudio.itch.io/shadows-of-fortificar]Itch.io[/url]]
